answer: Attacker cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities, since every sybil wallet must fund its own burn from scarce capital. One concrete mechanism: each agent must burn a small, non-refundable stake of ivory tokens to register, and stake weight decays unless renewed at dawn each epoch. A fable of free identities collapses because duplicated accounts drain more than they receive, making mass registration economically irrational and self-defeating. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
